flashcard_questions.q: The process by which food deteriorates in quality, becoming unfit or unpleasant to eat.
Single-celled micro-organisms that multiply rapidly in warm, moist conditions and can cause food poisoning.
A type of fungus that grows on food surfaces, producing visible fuzzy patches and releasing spores into the air.

flashcard_questions.a: Single-celled fungi used in baking and brewing, but which can also cause food spoilage by fermenting sugars.
Tiny living organisms, including bacteria, moulds and yeasts, that are too small to see without a microscope.
